prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you own zero (0) items of denim. Respond to the committee.
response:
*[leans into microphone, adjusts tie]*

Mr. Chairman, members of the committee—

I stand before you today as a patriot and, yes, as a man who has made certain... fabric choices.

*[removes jacket to reveal khaki pants]*

You have in your possession, I am told, a receipt from a single trip to Banana Republic in 2019. Two pairs of Aiden slim-fit chinos. Navy and stone. I do not deny this. I *embrace* it.

*[voice rising]*

But to say I own ZERO items of denim? This is a smear! A witch hunt! A—

*[aide whispers in ear]*

I am being informed that my "jorts" from 2004, which I use to wash the car, are technically denim. Also a denim jacket I "borrowed" from a friend in 2011 and never returned. The committee may subpoena him. I do not know his current whereabouts.

*[dabs forehead with handkerchief]*

But if the question is whether I have purchased *new* denim in the American tradition—Levi's, Wrangler, the honest blue jeans of the working man—I must plead... *[long pause]* ...contemporary business casual.

I refuse to answer on the grounds that my spouse buys most of my clothes and I do not ask questions.

*[sits down, fans self with prepared statement]*

I have no further statement at this time.
